environment.cpu: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

normalization: Unicode NFC, lowercase, collapse whitespace, keep punctuation; Levenshtein characters/words divided by reference length

memory.scope: Entire Node process including OCR worker threads; not browser peak heap or a per-page guarantee

limitations: Four synthetic single-column, upright fixtures. No real scan/camera/document corpus.
Noise is deterministic 1px gray dust; no blur/skew/rotation/degraded-paper benchmark.
Node engine benchmark proves pinned local engine/models, not browser worker loading, browser offline cache, or production accuracy.
